name: xiaohongshu_pugongying-mcp
display_name: 小红书 聚光 / 蒲公英 Xiaohongshu Ads MCP
description: 小红书 聚光 / 蒲公英 Xiaohongshu Ads (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Eve

platform_mcp_xiaohongshu_pugongying_clie.title: PLATFORM_MCP_XIAOHONGSHU_PUGONGYING_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_xiaohongshu_pugongying_clie.description: app_id of the 小红书开放平台 聚光 (MAPI) application (应用中心 > 编辑应用).

platform_mcp_xiaohongshu_pugongying_clie.title: PLATFORM_MCP_XIAOHONGSHU_PUGONGYING_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_xiaohongshu_pugongying_clie.description: secret of that application (应用中心 > 编辑应用); sent as `secret` in the refresh call.

platform_mcp_xiaohongshu_pugongying_refr.title: PLATFORM_MCP_XIAOHONGSHU_PUGONGYING_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_xiaohongshu_pugongying_refr.description: refresh_token from 获取token (auth_code exchange after the advertiser authorised the app's url). Valid 30 days and replaced on every refresh ('刷新后会生成新的 token，老的 access_token 和 refresh_token 将不可再使用'); set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the newest one survives restarts.

platform_mcp_xiaohongshu_pugongying_adve.title: PLATFORM_MCP_XIAOHONGSHU_PUGONGYING_ADVERTISER_ID
platform_mcp_xiaohongshu_pugongying_adve.description: 聚光 广告主ID (advertiser_id; returned as approval_advertisers with the token); used by the probe, update_budget and pause_resume.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No profile call exists for 聚光 MAPI; the probe lists one campaign of the configured advertiser (POST /api/open/jg/campaign/list, page_size 1).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: 查询计划 (POST /api/open/jg/campaign/list {advertiser_id, page {page_index, page_size ≤ 100}}): campaign_id, campaign_name, campaign_filter_state (1 有效, 2 暂停, 3 已删除, 4 计划预算不足, 5 现金余额不足 …), limit_day_budget, campaign_day_budget, marketing_target, placement, start_time, expire_time (numeric codes and the budget stay in raw). status is not sent (it is a numeric code).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: 标准投计划层级离线报表 (POST /api/open/jg/data/report/offline/campaign, time_unit DAY, first 500 rows): per campaign and day fee (消耗, 元), impression, click, interaction and conversion metrics as strings; data.aggregation_data has the totals. Offline data is ready from 10:00 the next day. campaign_id is not applied (filter rows by campaign_id).

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: 编辑计划 (POST /api/open/jg/campaign/update {advertiser_id, campaign_id, limit_day_budget: 1 指定预算, campaign_day_budget}) for the configured advertiser_id; daily_budget in 元 is sent in 分 (×100), the unit the MAPI uses for budgets (起量预算 '单位：分'; the campaign list sample shows campaign_day_budget 10000). Since 2026-09-01 this call no longer edits 产品种草 and 客资收集 campaigns ('停止支持…计划编辑'). This spends money; currency is ignored (CNY).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: 修改计划状态 (POST /api/open/jg/campaign/status/update {advertiser_id, campaign_ids, action_type}) with pause → 2 (暂停) and resume → 1 (开启); 3 (删除) is never sent. data.campaign_ids lists the campaigns actually changed. Resuming restarts spend.
